buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PR NO : 1006107938 Note: Only Designer Recommended source is eligible to participate in the tender. 1. MPATGM Project DRDL has shared the following documents vide letter No: DRDL/726/MPATGM/BDL, Dt: 31-Aug-2026 a. RCI DIIRS Letter ref No: RCI/MPATGM/Optics/2026/01, Dt: 20-08-2026 b. Supply Order copy No: DRDL/23AT0070/MPATGM/60/DOMR, Dt: 23-Jan-2023 c. Scope of work Ref: DRDO-RCI/3612/DIIRS/OU-May-1 for procurement of ZNS dome for Un-cooled Seeker configuration for MPATGM Project. (ii) Before executing the order the vendor has to confirm the final drawings with Designer RCI-DIIRS and DR DL MPATGM Project only. (iii) Parts/Components/Assembly shall be supplied as per the specification, drawings & QA plans as applica ble and confirmed by Designer RCI-DIIRS and DRDL MPATGM Project at the time of placement of order. (iv) Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA): Party shall submit the NDA duly signed with Seal (in the BDL format) . 2. All the deliverables will be verified for the Part / Article / Drg. Number (wherever applicable) with the par t/ article /Drg. number given in the Purchase order. (a) Required Raw Materials/Components is in Vendor Scope. (b) Vendor should not procure the raw material/bought out/imported items from countries sharing land bor der with India. (c) Only Designer DRDL recommended sources participation will be considered in the tender enquiry, resp onse received from non-recommended sources will be rejected. 3. (a) Inspection Agency: BDL and MSQAA / or its nominated agency. (b) Acceptance criteria: All the deliverables will be accepted based on the verification of complete test rep orts /Manufacturer’s COC / Self conformity certificate to be supplied along with the items (wherever applic able). (c) All the items/components/Sub-Systems are to be supplied by vendor/project as per the following docu ments (with latest amendments wherever applicable) (i) TS, MDI and BOM documents (ii) QAP, QTP and ATP documents. (iii) The changes, if any, as and when received from Designer (DRDL/RCI), the same will be intimated for an y correction. The vendor should consider the improvement and changes as recommended by design team (if any) through BDL within the delivery timelines. (iv) The firm should not have any claim in the design due to any changes during development and producti on. (v) All the latest revisions, versions, amendments, updations and changes are applicable. Vendors are requ ested to verify all the technical documents/drawings provided for the purpose of manufacturing of compon ents/assembly. Observations (if any) w.r.t higher revisions or updations/changes shall be submitted to BDL . If any design/QAP/drawing changes under proposal also to be submitted. (vi) MIL grade components should be procured as per the approved BOM document.

(vii) Latest QA matrix need to be followed and needs to be submitted to MSQAA. 4. Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): a) Vendor shall inform BDL and MSQAA at various stages as per applicable QAP document, one week prior to review/ witness and accordingly clearance will be given for further processing. b) Inspection by BDL QC & MSQAA at firm's site. Final dispatch clearance from inspection agency to be obt ained before delivery to BDL Stores along with PDI clearance report (or) Waiver to PDI issued by BDL. (c ) All the supplies should accompany with all the relevant inspection/test reports of the items cleared by the inspection agency (BDL QC & MSQAA). Final Acceptance after receipt of the items at BDL stores along with the PDI clearance Report (Signed by BDL QC & MSQAA). Warranty: One year from the date of accepta nce of material at BDL,Hyderabad against manufacturer defects only. 5. Delivery schedule: within 03 months from the date of receipt of Purchase order. However early deliverie s are also accepted. 6. (a) Vendor has to provide 30 percent additional quantity of consumables such as fasteners, nuts, washe rs etc. (wherever mentioned in drawings) separately along with the delivery of components / sub – assemblies/ assemblies. (b) The supplier shall ensure to reach the items with the required quality to BDL through adequate packagi ng without any damage. Identification/Traceability number should be marked on each Item. (c) Any damage or missing parts, vendor is liable and need to replace the same at free of cost. (d) The components should be free from Defects & Damages. (e) Packing & Forwarding: Items should be securely packed as per standard specification/ guidelines for se vere road transport conditions and packing charges to be borne by the supplier only. 7. Scope of work (Wherever applicable) needs to be submitted to /or MSQAA by Vendor/BDL for each PO wi th the following details: (i) Description of the sub-system (ii) Technical specifications of the system/Sub-system/module (iii)List of reference documents. (iv) List of FIM (if any) (v) Lot Size (if any) (vi) List of deliverables with cables, connectors, test jigs (if any.) 8. Vendor shall not have any claim in the design due to any changes during development and production. 9. The components shall be delivered to BDL stores (F.O.R BDL, Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad, Telangana Stat e-500058) at free of cost. 10. (a) Suitable Measuring Instruments and Gauges shall be available with the manufacturer for all basic in spection (Wherever applicable). (b) Valid Calibration certificates also to be supplied along with the test rep orts for the equipment’s, Gauges etc. used for the fabrication and inspection of the items. (c) Wherever facility for inspection is not available with the vendor, the inspection shall be done by the ve ndor at any of NABL certified Laboratory. Certificates for the same should also be supplied along with the d elivery. 11. Payment terms: (a) 90% basic value + 100% taxes will be paid within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of items at BDL . (b) Balance 10% will be paid against submission of Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) for 5 % PO value v alid till warranty period plus 3 months claim period. (c) In case of non-submission of PBG, 10 % payment will be released after satisfactory completion of warra

nty period only. (d) Payment will be made on pro-rata basis for accepted items. 12. Price Quoted: Free of cost at BDL Kanchanbagh, Hyderabad: i.e., inspection, packing & forwarding, frei ght insurance etc. are in supplier scope only. 13. (a) Bidder shall quote for all the items and full quantity of each item. (b) The evaluation will be done considering all the items as a set and L1 will be arrived based on overall lo west cost for the set. (c) Quotation for partial items/ partial quantities will not be considered. 14. Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product/Items against specification. 15. Supplier shall retain the product related records (Processes, Quality Records etc.) up to 3 years. 16. Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase ord er be aware of Product conformity requirements, Product safety and Importance of ethical behaviour etc. 17. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders for a period as decided by B DL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Or der / Service Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 18. Benefit of ITC Clause: (a) Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail. (b) Benefit of reduction in rate of GST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Co ntract, should be passed on to BDL without fail. (c) A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Managing partner/ Proprietor, as th e case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following format. “Certified that the be nefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurately passed on in terms of se ction 171 of the CGST Act.” 19. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 20. Option clause: BDL retains the right to place orders for additional quantity up to 100% of original order ed quantity at the same terms and conditions (at the same price). 21. BDL reserves the right to process and finalize the tender among the technically acceptable offers by co nducting on-line e-reverse auction ( after opening the price bids) and bringing all vendors to equal level pla ying field in respect of techno-commercial conditions or may finalize the tender without e-reverse auction , if required by BDL. The process adopted for e-reverse auction is at the discretion of BDL. The details of auc tioning will be given to the vendors in advance and familiarization will be arranged for the same, if require d. 22. The Prices indicated in the PO (After finalizing the bids and release of PO) are firm and fixed i.e., no sub ject alteration / variation on any account unless specified in the purchase order. 23. LD Clause: “Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to th e delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, withi n the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Inclu ding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part there of, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be bor ne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor”. 24. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
